import sys, uuid
import desktop.launcher as launcher
import pytest
launcher.NOME_MUTEX_INSTANCIA = 'Local\DZ23-V9-TestMutex-' + uuid.uuid4().hex
launcher.NOME_EVENTO_SAIDA = 'Local\DZ23-V9-TestEvento-' + uuid.uuid4().hex
def block_registry_writes(event, args):
    if event in ('winreg.CreateKey', 'winreg.SetValue', 'winreg.DeleteKey', 'winreg.DeleteValue'):
        raise RuntimeError('V9 local test isolation forbids Windows registry writes')
sys.addaudithook(block_registry_writes)
raise SystemExit(pytest.main(sys.argv[1:]))
